title: A 485-operation decoder for the bitset-certified 60-bit product

claims.statement: For the explicit systematic encoder with 33 [60,30] blocks and one [20,10] block, and the deterministic minimum-weight syndrome-leader decoder specified in proof.md, the average block error on a uniform 1000-bit message sent through 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 499976397292483003/500000000000000000.
For the same explicit systematic product code and chosen-leader decoder, the fixed bsc-ops-v1 RAM program uses exactly W=485 operations for every 2000-bit received word, with W <= 2^(4461/500).

experiments.purpose: Count distinct syndromes reachable at each weight through weight nine for the wide block and through saturation for the tail, then certify the error bound with exact integer arithmetic.
Count all primitive instructions, verify the exact operation exponent comparison, and check a reference-counter replay on sample inputs with exact precomputed table values at each accessed address.
